text:
Alex Kim: quick end-of-day relay — i'm handing primary over to Maria, Sam will stay secondary. TL;DR: brief KV-cache eviction spike earlier, transient 429s for a narrow customer cohort, we mitigated with throttling and a soft-fallback; no SLO breaches, customer-facing error rate back down to baseline.

incident-bot: [2098765600] alert: 3xx->5xx ratio for /v1/generate exceeded threshold (sev: soft) — auto-opened incident 2098765600.

Alex Kim: timeline in short — 20:46 UTC spike in cache evictions, 20:47 we started seeing 429s from the edge (mostly sessions from eu-west-1), 20:50 routed small fraction to warm pool and applied short-term rate limit for noisy keys, 20:57 error rate falling. Full mitigation at 21:05 UTC.

Maria Chen: looking at logs now, most of the requests were long-context (>= 4096 tokens). KV hit ratio dropped when sequences exceeded typical bucket sizes. Possible root cause: increased long-chat traffic from a single customer experiment.

Samir Patel: confirmed — customer id x-cust-881 did a big batch test ~20:40 UTC (we have an email thread). I throttled that customer via policy rule: `policy add rate_limit cid:x-cust-881 30r/s` which instantly reduced contention.

oncall-shadow: noted a small coverage gap last hour when warm pool autoscale lagged by ~90s due to kube-scaler cooldown. We've filed a follow-up.

Alex Kim: customer impact assessment: ~2.1% of requests for a 7-min window returned 429; 0.08% impacted overall daily traffic. No billing anomalies observed. No active customer escalations as of now.

incident-bot: attached logs (truncated):
```
2026-03-14T20:46:31Z ERROR evictor.go:128 key=kv-137 evictions=12
2026-03-14T20:46:45Z WARN router.go:254 resp=429 route=/v1/generate region=eu-west-1
2026-03-14T20:49:02Z INFO autoscaler.go:97 warmpool_scale=+2
```

Maria Chen: actions taken so far — applied rate limit to noisy customer, opened temporary warm pool scale up, enabled prefix-KV caching fallback for long-context requests.

Samir Patel: runbook pointer — see /runbooks/kv-evictions.md (section: "eviction surge, short mitigation"). Quick snippet I pasted into the channel earlier but copying again: 
```
if eviction_rate > 10/min:
  - enable warmpool +2
  - apply soft throttles to noisy customer keys
  - enable kv-prefix-fallback
  - monitor 5m error rate
```

Alex Kim: outstanding items / next steps for Maria (new primary):
- validate warmpool autoscale cooldown settings and propose config tweak (owner: infra)
- follow up with platform-eng to investigate long-context cache fragmentation (owner: eng-runtime)
- reach out to x-cust-881 via SEs to coordinate future load tests and avoid noisy bursts (owner: support/solutions)

Maria Chen: ack — i'll take primary, will run through the checklist now and post updates. I'll also open a targeted retro ticket and link repro traces.

oncall-shadow: creating action items in trello/ops: card #4281 with the autoscale tweak proposal + owner tags.

PagerDuty: page cleared: incident 2098765600 closed (soft) at 2098771100. No further pages to primary.

Alex Kim: notes for next shift: watch for long-context experiments and consider adding auto-throttle by max-context-length. If you see repeated 429s in a 5m window, apply the runbook throttles immediately.

Maria Chen: leaving a short handoff checklist for the morning oncall:
- confirm warmpool cooldown reduced to 30s if safe
- verify prefix-cache hit-rate has recovered >95% for affected models
- ensure SEs contacted the customer re: test schedule

Samir Patel: FYI i'll follow up on a patch to the autoscaler to avoid the 90s lag; will post PR link when ready.

Alex Kim: thanks team — tagging @oncall-shadow for continuity. i'm signing off as primary. :wave: 

oncall-shadow: acknowledged, taking notes for Monday morning review.

Maria Chen: signing in as primary — will ping in this thread with status changes or if anything regresses. :white_check_mark:
